items.title: Ran Blake interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 16, 2021
items.q: we have a marvelous jazz chairperson, Ken Schaphorst who does beautiful arrangements.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well you certainly have made an impact on a lot of people, and I thank you for that. I also am appreciative of how quiet your cat was during the interview.

He usually is more visible and I hope you’ll sometime visit Brookline, Massachusetts or the Conservatory in Boston because we’re celebrating our fiftieth anniversary next year. So people from the past, people there, and we have a marvelous jazz chairperson, Ken Schaphorst who does beautiful arrangements. And I continue still — I call what I do when I think of models — “recomposing” because I add myself but I still want to allude to, I want to allude to somebody else. You’re a great listener, Monk. You have been…
Thank you. I take that as a high compliment. So I’m going to pause our recording here and then we’ll have our official good-bye, all right?
